scope: Explicit any and non-null assertions in trading_repository.ts
verification: Node 22 tests/test_trading_core.js including four missing-readback fault injections
limitations: Static SQLite row interfaces describe the owned SQL schema; they do not replace runtime validation of stored JSON.
Update and publish methods historically perform writes outside a transaction; a failed readback does not roll back their successful write. Existing create and archive transactions do roll back.
